description: ATLAS tactics, techniques, and case studies data
commit_message:
Release v2026.09

This version of ATLAS data contains 1 matrix, 16 tactics, 120 techniques, 88 sub-techniques, 40 mitigations, and 73 case studies.

- Added new techniques

  - Triggers in Multimodal Inputs (AML.T0129)
  - AI Agent Response Biasing (AML.T0130)
  - Crafted AI Assistant Links (AML.T0131)
  - Misconfigured or Publicly Exposed AI Services (AML.T0132)
  - Discover AI Agent Runtime Capabilities (AML.T0133)
  - AI Targeted Cloaking (AML.T0134)
  - Search Open Technical Databases: Scan Databases (AML.T0000.003)
  - Active Scanning: Enumerate Hosted AI Resources (AML.T0006.000)
  - Active Scanning: Query Platform Metadata APIs (AML.T0006.001)
  - Active Scanning: Scan for Exposed AI Infrastructure (AML.T0006.002)
  - Active Scanning: Probe AI Agent Trigger Channels (AML.T0006.003)

- Updated existing techniques

  - Search Open Technical Databases (AML.T0000)
  - Search Open Website/Domains (AML.T0095)
  - Active Scanning (AML.T0006)
  - LLM Prompt Obfuscation (AML.T0068)
  - LLM Prompt Injection: Indirect (AML.T0051.001)
  - LLM Jailbreak (AML.T0054)
  - LLM Response Rendering (AML.T0077)
  - AI Agent Clickbait (AML.T0100)

- Added new mitigations

  - AI Honeypots (AML.M0039)

- Updated existing mitigations

  - Generative AI Guardrails (AML.M0020)

- Added new case studies

  - AI Recommendation Poisoning via Crafted AI Assistant Links (AML.CS0072)

- Updated existing case studies

  - ShadowRay: Hijacking Exposed Ray Clusters (AML.CS0023)
  - Data Exfiltration via Agent Tools in Copilot Studio (AML.CS0037)
  - Exposed ClawdBot Control Interfaces Leads to Credential Access and Execution (AML.CS0048)
  - Threat Actor Uses a DeepSeek-Powered Hermes Agent in Langflow and n8n Exploitation Attempts (AML.CS0070)
